findings.title: Repository foundation and bounded publication conform
findings.rationale: Role, profile, threat model, commands, records, packet, validation, integrity, review, exact private creation, and initial publication are complete; the closure commit's own equality is verified directly after publication.

findings.title: Canonical identity archive matches the packet projection
findings.rationale: The archive and current packet projection are byte-identical, and provenance records preserve the exact former locator and limitations.

findings.title: Three-capability conventions checkpoint is incomplete
findings.rationale: Verity lacks the FAM-036 packet identity/family lock, relative schema IDs collide across Titra/Ortha, and reference-to-import interoperability is unproven; second-wave generation remains blocked.

findings.title: Checkpoint publication completed under single-use authority
findings.rationale: The operator granted one additional checkpoint commit/push; the reviewed v1/v2 candidate is published once normally and final equality/cleanliness are verified directly.

findings.title: Profile-qualified successor checkpoint permits second-wave packet sequencing
findings.rationale: Legacy Verity and packet-specific Titra/Ortha are explicitly profiled; schema IDs are fully qualified; imports use consumer-owned transformation; no shared contract is promoted; six second-wave packets may proceed while Sibyl remains last.
